description: This file defines an Android activity demonstrating a grid-based user interface using the Wearable API, with a custom adapter creating colored and labeled pages in a GridViewPager.

classes.name: GridExampleActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the grid view pager.

classes.name: MainAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter for providing fragments and background drawables for each grid cell.

classes.name: MainFragment
classes.description: A fragment displaying a card with title and text indicating row and column indices.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity and sets up the grid view pager with its adapter.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns total number of rows in the grid.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns number of columns for a given row.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Creates new fragment instances for specific grid positions.

methods.name: getBackgroundForPage
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a bitmap background with row and column labels for each page.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new MainFragment instance with row and column labels.
